summary: Post-ceasefire snapback rally. US-Iran ceasefire (Apr 8) crashed oil -16% and triggered Dow's best day in a year (+3.9%). SPY 676 reclaimed 50-DMA. VIX 21.4 dropping fast. Gold holds $4,750 on safe-haven inertia. BTC $79.2K. Markets test whether ceasefire euphoria survives CPI (Apr 13) and Q1 earnings (JPM/WFC Friday).

risks.label: Ceasefire Fragility
risks.detail: US-Iran ceasefire just 24h old. Any violation or Hormuz incident reverses the entire rally. Polymarket gives 72% it holds 7 days.

risks.label: CPI Release April 13
risks.detail: Core consensus +0.28% m/m. A hot print would kill the June cut narrative (currently 52% priced). SPY could retrace to 660.

risks.label: Oil Crash Aftershock
risks.detail: WTI collapsed from $72 to $60.50 (-16%). Energy sector earnings will be hit. XLE -4.2% despite broad rally.

risks.label: Q1 Bank Earnings Friday
risks.detail: JPM/WFC/BLK report. Credit costs rising in consumer/autos. NIM improvement priced in — guidance is the risk.

risks.label: China Tariff Retaliation 125%
risks.detail: Beijing raised tariffs to 125% on US goods. Trade war escalation offset partially by geopolitical de-escalation.

risks.label: VIX Still Elevated at 21.4
risks.detail: Down from 28+ but still above 20. Regime score 0.41 = Early Risk-Off. Not yet risk-on.

risks.label: PLA Taiwan Drills Continuing
risks.detail: Live-fire exercises through weekend. Market ignoring for now but incident risk remains.

events.label: US-Iran Ceasefire Day 2
events.detail: Monitoring compliance. Oil markets repricing war premium out.

events.label: DAL Earnings BMO
events.detail: Q1 airline read — jet fuel cost collapse is a tailwind. Revenue guidance key.

events.label: ECB Lagarde Speech
events.detail: Frankfurt Finance Summit. Euro reaction to ceasefire + energy repricing.

events.label: 30Y Treasury Auction
events.detail: Post-rally demand gauge. Duration appetite after yields dropped.

events.label: Fri: JPM/WFC/BLK + PPI
events.detail: Q1 big bank kickoff + producer prices.

events.label: Sun: CPI March Release
events.detail: April 13 — the next binary event after ceasefire dust settles.

opportunities.label: DAL — Jet Fuel Collapse Play
opportunities.detail: Airlines are the #1 ceasefire beneficiary. Entry $66-68, TP1 $72, TP2 $78. Score 92.

opportunities.label: RCL — Cruise Lines Recovery
opportunities.detail: Fuel + consumer confidence tailwind. Entry $270-275, TP1 $290, TP2 $310. Score 90.

opportunities.label: NVDA — AI Leader Breakout
opportunities.detail: Risk-on rotation into growth. Entry $175-180, TP1 $195, TP2 $210. Score 91.

opportunities.label: USO Short — Oil Crash Continuation
opportunities.detail: War premium still unwinding. Below $60 opens $55 target.

opportunities.label: XLK — Tech Sector Recovery
opportunities.detail: Broad risk-on favors beaten-down tech. Entry $218-222, TP1 $235. Score 88.

opportunities.label: GLD — Safe Haven Holding
opportunities.detail: Gold barely dipped on ceasefire. Central bank buying structural. $4,700 support solid.

regimes.label: Early Risk-Off → Transitioning
regimes.detail: Regime score 0.41. VIX 21.4 dropping from 28+. Ceasefire catalyst could flip to Neutral within days if it holds.

regimes.label: Oil War Premium Collapse
regimes.detail: WTI -16% in 24h. Brent from $75 to $63. Biggest single-day oil move since 2020. Energy sector repricing.

regimes.label: Risk-On Rotation Starting
regimes.detail: Airlines +8%, cruises +6%, tech +3%. Defensive (utilities, staples) lagging. Classic ceasefire rotation.

regimes.label: Yield Curve Steepening
regimes.detail: 2s10s improving. Fed cut expectations rising on oil deflation impulse. 10Y 4.28%.
